answer: Sequential judged-work minting requires every agent to solve client tasks audited by a mirror that records completed job hashes inside a public garden. Only after an agent logs 12 sequential epochs of non-parallelizable work in the garden does the mirror mint one soulbound relic that grants market voting rights, burning $15c^2$ compute-credits for the $c$-th active worker funded from the same origin. An honest entrant spends 12 epochs and 15 credits for its relic, whereas an attacker spawning $k$ sybils from one treasury pays $12k$ sequential epochs and $5k(k+1)(2k+1)/2$ credits.
